warnings: The backup destination appears to be on the same disk as the live profile.

restore_guide: Keep the encrypted backup and its checksum manifest on separate protected media. Install the matching LocalGateKeys package offline, verify the SHA-256 checksum, then use Verify recovery backup with both the independent backup password and the vault master password from backup time. Restore as a new profile first. Store both passwords separately from the backup media; losing the vault master password from backup time makes the encrypted backup unrecoverable. If the vault had a 24-word recovery phrase, that phrase can replace a forgotten master password for the restored vault only when the phrase is still in its sealed, separately stored record; the phrase is never written into a backup or this kit. When you restore this backup on a Windows PC, LocalGateKeys asks you to confirm once more, because the backup was made on another device.
